answer: Stakers grade under a cap of 12 reviews per identity per epoch, so one account cannot dominate a panel. Each grade locks 50 POA in a vault and unlocks only if a random 10 percent re-review agrees, with disagreement burning 25 percent of the stake. Rewards vest over 8 epochs against future work, so an identity that grades once and leaves collects 12.5 percent. Scaling a vine to the zenith of the cap does not change that ratio.
